name: Active - Conceal

Unique Active - Conceals nearby allied heroes (including self) and grants them 40% extra Movement Speed for 5 seconds, or until they deal or take damage. 
 Heroes with this Blessing can gain EXP and Gold by dealing damage to enemy heroes (Cooldown: 15 seconds) or revealing enemies. This skill can only be unlocked after accumulating 1000 Gold from Thriving and Devotion.

name: Passive - Encourage
description:
Unique Passive - Grants nearby allied heroes (including self) 20 extra Hybrid Defense. 
 Heroes with this Blessing can gain 35% EXP and Gold from minions and creeps when allied heroes are nearby or by revealing enemies. This skill can only be unlocked after accumulating 1000 Gold from Thriving and Devotion.

name: Passive - Favor
description:
Unique Passive - Every 15 seconds, the next healing or shield skill recovers an 400 HP for the allied hero with the lowest HP (including self) within 5 units. Skills that only take effect on self cannot trigger this effect. 
 Heroes with this Blessing can gain 35% EXP and Gold from minions and creeps when allied heroes are nearby or by revealing enemy vision. This skill can only be unlocked after accumulating 1000 Gold from Thriving and Devotion.

name: Passive - Dire Hit
description:
Unique Passive - After dealing damage to an enemy hero, mark them for 3 seconds. Allied heroes' sttacks on marked targets deal additional Physical and Magic Damage equal to 12% of the target's Max HP. Cooldown: 15 seconds. 
 Heroes with this Blessing can gain EXP and Gold by dealing damage to enemy heroes (Cooldown: 15 seconds) or revealing enemy vision. This skill can only be unlocked after accumulating 1000 Gold from Thriving and Devotion.
